hypothesis: Cleanup has a fixed branch cost in addition to its per-finishing-request cost. Combining that branch indicator with the small-prefill term tests both effects within four expressions.

pcvs.expression: len([r for r in self.running if r.num_output_tokens + 1 >= r.max_tokens])
pcvs.name: finishing_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-request completion and resource release.

pcvs.expression: 2 * (len([r for r in self.running if r.num_output_tokens + 1 >= r.max_tokens]) > 0) + (3 * max(0, 3 - len(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs)) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs else 0)
pcvs.name: cleanup_and_small_prefill
pcvs.rationale: Combines the fixed cost of stopped-request queue cleanup with the observed excess cost of small prefill batches.
